indicators.label: Unusually long URL
indicators.why: Very long web addresses can be used to push the real destination out of sight.

indicators.label: Many subdomains
indicators.why: A long chain of subdomains can make a fake address look like a familiar one.

indicators.label: Many dot-separated parts
indicators.why: Several domain components can make an address harder to interpret.
